task.description:
Design integration tests for TNT-01, TNT-02, TNT-03, and TNT-04.

TNT-01 tests:
- Provision a tenant; inspect tenant schema; verify all 19 business tables exist inside tenant_<uuid>; verify none exist in public with tenant data
- Provision two tenants A and B; query tenant_<A>.events; verify no rows from tenant B are returned

TNT-02 tests:
- Call migration runner for a fresh tenant schema; verify tables land in tenant schema (not public)
- Verify migration runner issues SET search_path = <schema>, public before SQL execution
- Run tools/lint_migration_schema.py against a migration with 'public.events': verify exit code non-zero
- Run tools/lint_migration_schema.py against a migration with 'public.schema_migrations': verify exit code 0
- Verify schema_migrations tracking uses (schema_name, version) composite PK

TNT-03 tests:
- Acquire a connection for tenant swiftroute; execute SHOW search_path; verify it contains tenant schema
- Return connection to pool; acquire again with no tenant; execute SHOW search_path; verify it shows public only
- Two concurrent requests for different tenants: verify each connection has correct independent search_path

TNT-04 tests:
- Start platform with public schema containing only permitted tables; verify INFO 'public schema audit: CLEAN' is logged
- Add an unexpected table to public; start platform; verify ERROR is logged naming the unexpected table
- Verify no hard-stop occurs when unexpected table is found

All tests: use per-test UUIDs for tenant IDs, clean up after themselves, fail clearly if BPM_TEST_DB_URL is absent.
Write test specs to tests/specs/TNT-01.md, TNT-02.md, TNT-03.md, TNT-04.md.
Write test source files to tests/integration/tnt_schema_isolation_test.zig (or per-requirement files).
Set next_action: 'Route to TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR (Step 3b)'

REWORK 1 (from TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR):

BLOCKER — TC-TNT-04-04 behavioral gap:
The implemented test only checks that migration_window_active column exists. It does NOT test the WARN-vs-ERROR behavior during a migration window. Required: write a test that (1) sets migration_window_active=TRUE in onboarding_registry, (2) creates an unexpected table in public, (3) calls auditPublicSchema, (4) verifies WARN level is emitted (not ERROR). Clean up in defer blocks.

MAJOR — lint_test_isolation.py T020 false-positives on tnt_schema_isolation_test.zig:
The linter exits 1 with 18 MAJOR T020 findings — all false positives (indented local var declarations flagged as module-level mutable vars). Fix by either:
  Option A: Add the 18 false-positive entries to tools/lint_test_isolation.baseline.json
  Option B: Fix the T020 heuristic in tools/lint_test_isolation.py to only flag var at true column 0 (no leading whitespace)
Choose the correct approach: Option B is the right fix (improves the linter); Option A is acceptable if B risks regressions.
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/TNT-01.md exists with test cases for all TNT-01 acceptance criteria
tests/specs/TNT-02.md exists with test cases for all TNT-02 acceptance criteria including linter tests
tests/specs/TNT-03.md exists with test cases for all TNT-03 acceptance criteria
tests/specs/TNT-04.md exists with test cases for all TNT-04 acceptance criteria
Integration test source file(s) exist in tests/integration/ for all requirements
All fixtures use per-test UUIDs (no hardcoded tenant IDs)
Tests check for BPM_TEST_DB_URL and fail clearly if absent
No error.SkipZigTest on any MUST requirement test

result.summary: REWORK 1 complete: TC-TNT-04-04 now tests WARN-vs-ERROR behavioral switch by setting migration_window_active TRUE/FALSE and calling auditPublicSchema in both phases; T020 heuristic fixed in lint_test_isolation.py by changing regex from ^\s*var to ^var (column-0 anchor) eliminating 18 false-positive MAJOR findings.
